## The demo app (`apps/demo`)

- Pages live in `src/app/pages/<name>/<name>.component.ts`, standalone + `OnPush`,
  built only from `@brand/ui` (a raw `nz-table` is allowed to show ng-zorro is
  skinned too).
- `app.config.ts` wires `provideAnimations()`, `provideNzI18n`, `provideNzIcons`
  (register every icon name you use), and `provideBrandTheme({ brand: 'brand-3' })`.
- The build `styles` order is fixed: `tokens.css` → `antd.css` → `antd-dark.css`
  → `ng-zorro-tokens.css` → `base.css` → app styles.
